create_CPPNodeConfig: create a CPPNodeConfig with a cpp_class type and optional args list for C++ node configuration
create_CPPNode: create a CPPNode instance with a config containing a cpp_class to auto-register C++ topics and streams
run_CPPNode: run the CPPNode async run method to execute the underlying C++ node in a background executor thread
setup_CPPNode: setup the CPPNode by instantiating the C++ class with config args and calling the C++ setup method
configure_CPPNode: configure an existing CPPNode with new args while preserving the original cpp_class reference
